mechanism: Phenelzine (MAOI) inhibits monoamine oxidase, and chlorpromazine has dopamine antagonist and anticholinergic properties, creating additive CNS depression, hypotensive effects, and potential hypertensive crisis risk with indirect sympathomimetic activity.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if necessary, use with extreme caution at reduced doses with close monitoring of blood pressure, mental status, and cardiac function.
